name: deckromm
description: Controller-first RomM client for Steam Deck and SteamOS Game Mode
author: DeckRomM <deckromm@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.check:main: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && for f in electron/lib/*.cjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.pack:dir: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux dir
scripts.dist:appimage: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:appimage:npm: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux AppImage
